title: Keep nine niche choices consistent through Space setup

source.ref: Owner all-open-work handoff 2026-11-13, P1-2: nine optional What are you building? hero choices after the shared resume record.

detail: Adds the nine requested chips to the existing look controls. A server boundary derives their canonical niches and exact modes from FunnelConfig.niche and NICHE_FUNNEL_DESTINATIONS and passes only bounded choices to the client. Public slug aliases preselect the matching chip; a registered explicit URL mode retains precedence. Typed offer goals add to the chosen setup instead of replacing the niche. The validated optional modeHint stays in the existing draft/resume JSON, survives a draft-free anonymous hold and is revalidated before provisioning. Only a full validated unattached builder draft can update the launch row's existing niche/intents columns in the same owner/revision CAS write; metadata-only, handover and attached-Space paths cannot rewrite them. New focused regressions cover nine-door parity, malformed hints, chip interaction, goal merging, hold continuity, provision parameters and concurrent row updates. Existing assertions and probes are unchanged. The unchanged consequence probe fails against the reviewed P1 consumers (Appointments instead of Packages) with only new helper scaffolding present and passes after integration. No migration, send, rollout switch or production activation is asserted by this source row. The exact title and nine niches come from the owner's handoff; no design baseline was raised. A niche-only pick counts as recoverable progress before a name is typed; a new mounted-component regression first failed with zero shared-resume saves and passes once the existing progress guard includes niche/mode choices. Extracted only the previously unpublished niche commit1557eff05 onto current main7a71, preserving the already merged P1-1 resume/auth/recovery source and the occupied LIVE-2286 preview row. Reassigned only the fragment ID; the source probe and existing test assertions remain unchanged. Failing-today run against current consumers plus helper scaffolding returned Appointments rather than the selected Packages mode before integration. No SQL or production activation.
